answer: Reputation here behaves like a river that flows only along endorsements from established agents, and each endorser's outflow is capped per epoch. A new identity starts as an island: it can submit work, but its rewards stay locked until several independent peers route trust to it. A sybil farm can mint a thousand islands overnight, yet the channel feeding them is only as wide as the few real endorsers it controls, so the whole flock splits one trickle. The comet of fresh accounts arrives bright and fades unpaid.
